Some generally helpful information which you can also use going forward:

  • You can see which games you already own by installing Steam in Linux. It adds a SteamOS+Linux filter to the Games tab.
  • You can go to the store (through the client or your browser), mouse over Games, and click SteamOS + Linux at the bottom of the list. Then you can do things like sort by user reviews or price.
  • If you're looking at search results in the store, mousing over a game will show a Steam Play box with supported systems. The Windows logo for Windows, the Apple logo for OSX, and the Steam logo for SteamOS and Linux.
  • If you're on a particular game page in the store, the System Requirements section will have a SteamOS + Linux tab if it's supported.
